description:
List the user's recently uploaded media (dashboard Media library + API uploads): url, type (image/video), file name, size and upload date, ready to pass into create_post's mediaItems.

Use this whenever the user references media they've already uploaded — "my latest upload", "the video I uploaded", "that reel from earlier" — instead of asking them for a URL. This is THE path for posting videos from chat: big files can't travel through the conversation, so the user uploads once on the dashboard Media page and you reference it from here.

type.description: Only return this media type ('pdf' = LinkedIn documents).

name: list_media
title: List Media
